Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group provides a comprehensive offering for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are seeking a diligent and insightful Responsible Investment Analyst to join our Research team. In this role, you will lead PWM’s proxy voting programme, including voting analysis, recommendation development, and coordination of voting decisions, while overseeing relationships with proxy voting and stewardship service providers. You will also manage the sustainability data ecosystem supporting investment and reporting activities and help integrate new sustainability indicators into investment tools and processes.

The role requires a strong understanding of responsible investment, particularly proxy voting, as well as knowledge of ESG data providers, sustainability frameworks, and reporting standards. You should be comfortable operating across investment, sustainability, and technology functions, with the ability to manage complex data-driven projects and operational processes. Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills will be essential.

Your role

Stewardship and Active Ownership

• Lead PWM's proxy voting programme, including voting analysis, recommendation development and coordination of voting decisions.
• Oversee relationships with proxy voting and stewardship service providers.

ESG Data Management

• Manage the sustainability data ecosystem supporting investment and reporting activities.
• Support the integration of new sustainability indicators into investment tools and processes.

Your profile

• Strong understanding of responsible investment, especially related to proxy voting.
• Knowledge of ESG data providers, sustainability frameworks and reporting standards.
• Ability to bridge investment, sustainability and technology functions.
• Experience managing complex data-driven projects and operational processes.
• Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.

Starting date : 11 January 2027

Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà dei partner offre un'offerta completa per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare.

Stiamo cercando un analista responsabile per gli investimenti diligente e intuitivo per unirsi al nostro team di ricerca. In questo ruolo, guiderai il programma di voto proxy di PWM, tra cui l'analisi delle votazioni, lo sviluppo delle raccomandazioni e il coordinamento delle decisioni di voto, mentre supervisionerai le relazioni con i fornitori di servizi di voto e di gestione proxy. Potrai anche gestire l'ecosistema dei dati di sostenibilità supportando le attività di investimento e reporting e contribuire a integrare nuovi indicatori di sostenibilità in strumenti e processi di investimento.

Il ruolo richiede una forte comprensione degli investimenti responsabili, in particolare il voto proxy, nonché la conoscenza dei fornitori di dati ESG, dei quadri di sostenibilità e degli standard di reporting. Si dovrebbe essere a proprio agio ad operare attraverso le funzioni di investimento, sostenibilità e tecnologia, con la capacità di gestire complessi progetti basati sui dati e processi operativi. Saranno essenziali competenze analitiche, di comunicazione e di gestione degli stakeholder.

Stewardship e proprietà attiva

• Condurre il programma di voto proxy PWM, tra cui l'analisi delle votazioni, lo sviluppo delle raccomandazioni e il coordinamento delle decisioni di voto.
• Controllare le relazioni con i fornitori di servizi di voto proxy e di gestione.

Gestione dei dati ESG

• Gestire l'ecosistema dei dati di sostenibilità supportando le attività di investimento e reporting.
• Sostenere l'integrazione di nuovi indicatori di sostenibilità in strumenti e processi di investimento.

Il tuo profilo

• Forte comprensione degli investimenti responsabili, soprattutto legati al voto proxy.
• Conoscenza dei fornitori di dati ESG, dei framework di sostenibilità e degli standard di reporting.

The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.
As a Client Relationship Officer in our Zurich office you will be working in the Eastern Europe Market and you will be the point of entry for all operational requests from bankers or clients.

Your role

• Administer the end-to-end account-opening process, taking into consideration local regulatory specificities
• Secure strict follow-up of documentation (e.g.pending items, middle office and R&C lists)
• Assist documentation flows (e.g.archiving and processing physical and electronic forms)

• Edit payments and transfers while ensuring call backs are systematically performed
• Build close relationships with relevant internal stakeholders
• Support assistance with administrative tasks when required

Your profile

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification
• Minimum of two years experience in a similar function
• Fluency in English & Russian. German languages is a plus
• Understand client documentation and internal processes of a wealth manager
• Familiar with regulatory dimensions (cross-border, R&C, PEP, CARA, FATCA, CRS, etc.)
• Attention to detail
• Reliable and resilient, with a strong sense of responsibility and an ability to multi-task
• Solutions-oriented and proactive mindset

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group provides a comprehensive offering for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are seeking a Sustainability Manager, joining the Sustainability Team which supports the advancement of Pictet’s sustainability strategy across the private bank.
You will report directly to the Sustainability Lead and work day to day with PWM’s investment platform and sustainability colleagues across the Group.

Your role

• Support the delivery of PWM’s Sustainability Ambition 2030 by translating strategic priorities into concrete initiatives and business outcomes.
• Coordinate the development, enhancement and roll-out of responsible investing solutions across locations, in line with evolving regulatory requirements.
• Support the continued strengthening of PWM’s responsible investing framework, methodologies, policies and governance.
• Help shape and develop PWM’s impact investing mandate, including the underlying data, reporting capabilities and operational groundwork required to support this investment solution effectively.
• Lead and monitor key sustainability-related initiatives across products, ESG data, reporting, active ownership topics and tool/process improvements.
